name: Task Field Labels
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
A folder rule now selects a preset whose name contains a bar character instead of a different preset.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Pro folder rules now pick the right preset when the preset name has a | character in it.
tip: Labels show in Reading view. Tasks query results show them in Live Preview too.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Task Field Labels is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to keep your tasks in order.
